title: Exact Minimum Active S-Boxes in SKINNY
summary: Most reported active-S-box bounds for SKINNY are not tight and may underestimate the minima; determining tight minimum counts remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine the exact minimum numbers of active $\mathrm{S}$-boxes in SKINNY differential characteristics. Most reported bounds on these numbers are not tight, and the true minima may be higher; the unresolved task is to establish tight minimum active-$\mathrm{S}$-box counts.

scope.domain: Differential cryptanalysis of the lightweight block cipher SKINNY.
parameters: Active S-box count — the quantity minimized over SKINNY differential characteristics
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish the exact, tight minimum active-S-box counts.

citations.label: The SKINNY Family of Block Ciphers and Its Low-Latency Variant MANTIS

progress.summary: The paper reports active-S-box bounds for SKINNY but emphasizes that most are not tight and that higher minima may be possible, leaving the exact tight counts open.
citation_labels: Christof Beierle et al., The SKINNY Family of Block Ciphers and Its Low-Latency Variant MANTIS
